## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q`, `ruff check .` and `mypy` pass
- [ ] Rule changes still go through a `Proposal` and `loop.approve` (one door in)
- [ ] New reasoning steps have an offline implementation and a test
- [ ] Model output is treated as untrusted (ids validated, text fenced as data)
- [ ] No API keys, real chat exports or personal data in code, tests or fixtures
- [ ] README / docs / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
